task: Write a PL/SQL block that uses JSON_TABLE to iterate invoices and print totals.

task: Find products with net stock below their reorder level.
gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN m.movement_type='IN' THEN m.qty ELSE -m.qty END),0) AS net FROM llm_log_products p LEFT JOIN llm_log_stock_movements m ON m.product_id=p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_name, p.reorder_level HAVING NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN m.movement_type='IN' THEN m.qty ELSE -m.qty END),0) < p.reorder_level ORDER BY p.product_name;
validation_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT p.product_name FROM llm_log_products p LEFT JOIN llm_log_stock_movements m ON m.product_id=p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_name, p.reorder_level HAVING NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN m.movement_type='IN' THEN m.qty ELSE -m.qty END),0) < p.reorder_level);
